title: Interactivity oracle: drive compiled SWF in Ruffle with synthesized input (e2e harness)
description: Per docs/18-verification-and-automation.md. The visual oracle only covers static rendering; nothing verifies input -> AS2 script -> hitTest -> screen in a published SWF. Build a Playwright e2e harness that loads a compiled SWF in the Ruffle player, dispatches synthesized mouse/keyboard events, advances frames, and asserts resulting state (screenshot diff and/or a __flashTest bridge reading player state). Reuse visual-oracle learnings in CLAUDE.md (on-screen player, deviceScaleFactor:1, port 1420). This harness is the verification backbone for the capstone game task and for button/keyboard regressions.
